title: 心理実習
subtitle: Practical Training in Psychology
keywords: Team approach 2.Multi-professional and community collaboration 3.Understanding of professional ethics 4.Understanding of legal obligations
educationalGoal: In this practical training, students will learn and understand the following issues through observation and other practical training. (a) Team approach to those who need psychological support (b) Multi-professional cooperation and community collaboration (c) Understanding of professional ethics and legal obligations as a licensed psychologist
advice: This class consists of off-campus practical training and pre- and post- instruction. Students will learn about the following three main topics through these activities. (a) Team approach to those who need psychological support (b) Multi-professional cooperation and community collaboration (c) Understanding of professional ethics and legal obligations as a licensed psychologist Practical training will be offered throughout the year. The classes are scheduled for various practical training at six facilities. First of all, in the preliminary study, the instructor will instruct the students on how to prepare for the practical training. Students are required to understand and comply with the code of ethics for licensed psychologists and the rules set for practical training at each facility. If students deviate from these rules, they may be suspended from practical training. In addition, students should research and understand the legal status and characteristics of each facility and its role in the community.
books: Guidebook for Health and Medical Practice for Certified Psychologist Training
requiredKnowledge: This course is required to obtain the national certification as a licensed psychologist. Students must have completed all courses for licensed psychologists offered by the third year.

activityGoals.body: Ability to describe the roles of the staffs involved in providing support, based on their practical experience.
Ability to describe the significance of support through multi-professional and community collaboration.
Ability to be able to give examples of professional ethics and legal obligations as a licensed psychologist.

achievementLevels.ideal: Explain the knowledge (team approach, multidisciplinary cooperation, community cooperation, etc.) they have learned from textbooks and lectures by applying it to the specific activities of licensed psychologists in each practice facility. Express their own thoughts on how they are expected to support people who need psychological support and the people involved. Explain the actual professional ethics and legal obligations of licensed psychologists through practice.
achievementLevels.standard: Explain the knowledge (team approach, multidisciplinary cooperation, community cooperation, etc.) they have learned from textbooks and lectures by applying it to the specific activities of licensed psychologists in each practice facility. Explain the actual professional ethics and legal obligations of licensed psychologists through practice.

lessons.content: Course introduction Overview of psychological practice, course requirements, and preparedness for practical training
lessons.operation: Lecture and practice Group work Discussions Oral presentations
lessons.assignments: Students should prepare and review the legal status of licensed psychologists, professional ethics, informed consent, team approach, and multi-professional and community collaboration.

lessons.content: Practical training at medical institutions and other training facilities. Prior learning: Group work, presentation and discussion on the training facility. Practical training: Participation in the practical training program at the training facility. Post-learning: Summary of practical training and self-evaluation report.
